entries.final_answer: Yes. Operator ruling 'One Mission, all three' (dispatcher relay, research and alignment squad transcript ledger R68).
entries.question: Should #7808, #5297 and #5516 ship as one Mission?

entries.final_answer: Scope decides (operator ruling): only spec.md, tasks/ and closing keywords (Closes/Fixes/Resolves #N, any file) gate. Any other #N (research.md, plan.md, analysis-report.md, contracts/, tables, 'Break #19') is cited and non-gating. Amend ADR 2026-09-20-1 (FR-011). Keep one classifier authority and converge the three detector copies onto it.
entries.question: Which mission artifacts may produce a gating issue reference?

entries.final_answer: Reject a leading zero in every issue-number pattern, and filter an all-digit hex colour only in CSS declaration form (property: #hex), never by a CSS keyword elsewhere on the line (hand-off on #7808). Backticks stay an allowed prefix.
entries.question: How should hex colour values like #000000 and #112233 be excluded?

entries.final_answer: A backticked 7-40 hex SHA within a short window of the citation's # classifies the occurrence PR_OR_COMMIT_REF (cited, non-gating) (#5297 suggested fix, dispatcher brief).
entries.question: When is a #N next to a commit SHA a non-gating citation?
